description: We are a group of people who are curious about space and want to learn more about it, discover what exists in the universe, explore planets and galaxies, and understand how everything works. We want to expand our knowledge and discover the mysteries of the universe.
summary:
Our project, “The Footprints of NASA Across Space,” is about the machines and equipment NASA has sent into space to explore different places in the universe. Through an educational story, we want to explain how they work, why they were sent, and what they have discovered. We focus on Apollo 11 on the Moon, the Sojourner rover on Mars, and Voyager 1 and 2 in deep space.

Our goal is to show that space exploration is not only about astronauts and rockets, but also about technology that helps us explore places humans cannot easily reach. We want to inspire students to become curious about science, technology, and the mysteries of the universe.
details: Our project, “The Footprints of NASA Across Space,” is an educational story about three important NASA missions: Apollo 11, Sojourner, and Voyager 1 and 2. It explains the purpose of each mission, the equipment used, and their discoveries. Through images and information, we want to make space exploration easier to understand and inspire students to learn more about science and the universe.
